description: Fork of exp586 (E=384/d_v=64 full arch, 1.4509 SoTA). SINGLE change: residual_tph 128 -> 256, doubling the per-layer residual_lut table count. This is the proven exp530 lever (residual_tph 128->256 gave -0.0094 on the E=64 backbone) applied on top of the E-sweep SoTA. Predicted +18.87M params (residual_lut 3.15M -> 6.29M per layer × 6) -> ~280M total. Predicted +9.4 Mbits trunk -> 155 Mbits trunk, total ~558 Mbits/tok. Tests whether the residual_tph lever still pays at E=384 backbone with all the prior wins stacked. If yes, this is a cheap cumulative gain (+7% params for hopefully -5-10 mb). If no, residual_tph effectiveness was scale-dependent and saturates at E=384. Refs: exp586 1.4509 @261M/549 (parent), exp530 -0.0094 at E=64, exp565 1.4513 @175M (matmul-free SoTA reference from prior work — exp587 should beat it cleanly), exp328 1.3882 (vanilla).
